target_customer: Originally non-engineer knowledge workers building AI agents; the current site targets consumers who read interactive romance and fan fiction stories
problem: Launch pitch: make AI agents ten times easier to build for non-engineers. Current product: interactive AI stories where the reader plays the lead.
business_model: Free consumer app, monetization not stated
product_category: AI agent workspace, later consumer AI interactive story app

founders.name: Linus Talacko
previous_startups: Lyrebird Health, co-founded at 19, scaled to 50+ people (outcome not stated)

founders.name: Justin Lee
founders.background_notes: Built AI agents at Atlassian, joined Lyrebird as founding engineer per YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Both the agent workspace and the chat based story app are built on commodity LLMs and standard app engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Story content and agent workspaces were easy to copy; the current site relies on unofficial fan stories of franchises, which adds IP risk rather than a moat.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Slack and Notion both added AI agents during 2025; no acquisition of Den found.

market_need_then: No company specific demand evidence found for either the agent workspace or the story app.

branding.domain_note: Used getden.io, which now redirects to denofus.com (observed 301 redirect).

identity.voice_and_tone: Playful, flirty, lowercase teasing story blurbs on denofus.com

rebrands.to: Den of Us (interactive story app, denofus.com)
rebrands.why: Not stated; inferred only from the getden.io redirect, so treat as unconfirmed.

brand_strength.rationale: Generic one word name that searches poorly (results were dominated by other companies named Den); no press about the brand.

pivots.from: Agent workspace, 'Cursor for knowledge workers' (YC launch post)
pivots.to: Interactive AI story app, Den of Us
pivots.why: Not stated; the YC tagline is 'Make real life a video game' and getden.io redirects to denofus.com, so the link between the two products is inferred.

outcome_analysis: Den is a Spring 2025 company from founders who previously scaled Lyrebird Health and built agents at Atlassian. It launched as an agent workspace and its old domain now points to a consumer interactive story app, which suggests a pivot, but no source states it. No funding, traction or outcome is public, so the record shows an early stage company with unclear direction.
notes: getden.io returned a 301 redirect to denofus.com; the link between the YC company and Den of Us is inferred from that redirect only. A StartupIntros listing shows a $500K seed in 2025-06 with angels (Nir Eyal, Balaji Srinivasan) but it was not confirmed to be this company, so no round is recorded. Dated competitors for the agent workspace pitch were not searched beyond a gamified life app query that returned unrelated consumer apps, so the list is empty. The YC one-liner (real life as a video game) differs from the launch post (agent platform).
